articles.title: Europe, Canada pull together in Yerevan in Trump's shadow
articles.summary: The Canadian Prime Minister said in Yerevan that gatherings like the one with European leaders point to a better way forward, rejecting a "transactional, insular, and brutal world." The statement came as leaders met in the Armenian capital.

articles.title: Modi’s B.J.P. Wins West Bengal State Election for the First Time
articles.summary: The B. J. P., led by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, won control of West Bengal for the first time in state elections. Its opponents accused the party of cheating. The party of Prime Minister Narendra Modi took control of West Bengal for the first time and made gains around the country.

articles.summary: Wealthy elites are shifting assets out of Dubai to Singapore and Switzerland. Amid the smoldering Iran war, wealthy elites are quietly shifting capital and other assets out of Dubai and heading to Singapore and Switzerland.

articles.title: Nigerian refinery accused of sacking union members is key to UK plan to tackle jet fuel shortage
articles.summary: A Nigerian refinery, accused of sacking union members, is crucial to the UK's plan to address a jet fuel shortage. The UK government hopes to import more fuel from the US and West Africa to mitigate the crisis.

articles.title: UAE reports missile and drone strikes incoming from Iran
articles.summary: The UAE reported incoming missile and drone strikes from Iran, with no immediate reports of casualties. Iran has not commented on the incident, which raises concerns about the escalating tensions in the region.

articles.summary: The UAE stated it was under attack from Iranian missiles and drones, despite a ceasefire. The incident highlights the ongoing security challenges in the region, with the UAE facing continued threats from Iranian actions.

articles.title: Iran Fires 'Warning Shots' At US Warships In Strait Of Hormuz
articles.summary: Iranian forces fired warning shots at US warships in the Strait of Hormuz, according to reports. The incident occurred amid heightened tensions between the two nations. The Fars news agency had earlier reported that Iran hit a US warship with missiles.

articles.title: South Korean Ship Targeted Amid Tensions In Hormuz
articles.summary: A South Korean ship was targeted in the Strait of Hormuz. The 24 crew members on board reported no casualties. There had been "no casualties to date" among the 24 crew members on board (file image).

articles.title: OCBC to buy HSBC wealth, premier banking portfolio in Indonesia
articles.summary: OCBC will buy HSBC's wealth and premier banking portfolio in Indonesia, increasing its assets under management by 25 per cent. The deal will transfer HSBC Indonesia's International Wealth and Premier Banking portfolio to PT Bank OCBC NISP, or OCBC Indonesia, and is expected to increase OCBC Indonesia's assets under management by 25 per cent.
